newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists turn neutral on AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists turn neutral on AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists said on Monday sentiment had turned neutral on prospects for the AEX share index and most predicted a period of sideways trading ahead.
However, the longer-term bullish picture was still intact but a breakout higher was needed to confirm this, they added.
"The AEX has violated its rising trend channel, indicating a pause for breath," ING Barings said, adding that unless the market broke below 670, there was little downside potential.
The index ended at 675.68 points on Friday, one point below the previous Friday. In the week before that the index had gained more than six points.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ABN AMRO - The AEX has violated its rising trend channel, indicating a pause for breath. For the short term the charts show a congestion area between 670 and 685. Current technicals do not suggest downside potential unless 670 gives way. Money flow remains very strong indicating that investors remain active on the buy side of the market. The Advance/Decline ratio, measuring culmulative difference between winners and losers, is topping a bit. This indicates that, for the time being, there is no leadership in the market. A break above 686 is required to have the previous up trend resumed.

ING Barings - Important support for the short term is being tested at the present AEX level. On the very short term 676 first acted as an intermediate resistance and has now turned into a short-term support level. First serious support lies at 659. Our first target still is the psychological resistance level of 700. Our medium target lies around 720. In our view the index has succeeded in finding clear direction on the medium term, therefore staying long is the best strategy. The possible dips in the market are buying opportunities. Suitable price levels to increase long positions are 678, 680 and 686.

IRIS - The AEX broke the short-term rising trend line. This triggered a trading range between 666 and 686. We expect this range to remain intact for this week. If one of the boundaries gives way, a follow-up move in the direction of the breakout may be expected.
